newsitem.title: FRANCE: Full text of Trichet statement on French rates.
newsitem.headline: Full text of Trichet statement on French rates.

text.p: Following is the full text of Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet's comments following Thursday's cut in the intervention rate to 3.10 percent:
"The Monetary Policy Council has decided to lower the Banque de France repurchase tenders rate to 3.10 percent. This is the lowest rate the Banque de France has ever given for its repurchase tenders.

"In making this move, the Monetary Policy Council wished to send a signal of confidence as part of its monetary strategy for the credibility and stability of the French franc amongst the most credible European currencies. The solidity of our currency within the Exchange Rate Mechanism is an integral part of the Banque of France's monetary policy, in line with the strategy for Economic and Monetary Union adopted by the President of the Republic and the French Government.

"The Monetary Policy Council considers that our rate for repurchase tenders is presently at the appropriate level in view of the French and international economic environment. The Council has no plans at this stage to change this rate at its upcoming meetings.

"French market medium- and long-term interest rates are at the lowest level in the European Union, together with Dutch and German rates, and at the third lowest level in the world. The monetary and financial conditions are ripe for sustained economic growth and job creation. It is the right time for businesses and households to invest."
